selection_rationale: The Local-54 ledger already has a numeric official county value for all 47 counties.
KDHS 2022 directly measures child anthropometry, so the target is not a proxy substitution.
The constituency and ward matrix rows are feasibility C with small_area_estimation explicitly permitted by survey_small_area policy.
A successful engine is reusable for other KDHS health indicators after indicator-specific outcome definitions and validation thresholds are declared.

minimum_requirements: same covariate definitions available at cluster-training and prediction-grid locations
population surface suitable for population-weighted aggregation

modelling_design.observation_unit: KDHS cluster-level stunted-child numerator/eligible-child denominator derived outside the public repository
modelling_design.weighting: survey weights retained when forming cluster sufficient statistics and validation aggregates
location_handling: Never assign a displaced DHS cluster directly to a ward as ground truth.
Extract training covariates using displacement-aware buffers/sensitivity rather than assuming the published coordinate is exact.
Predict on a regular grid or other small spatial support, then aggregate predictions to constituency/ward using population weights.
modelling_design.spatial_structure: spatial random field or equivalent spatial smoother plus declared fixed covariates and county/urban-rural effects where justified
modelling_design.county_controls: County KDHS estimates are held out during validation folds; final production predictions may be calibrated/reconciled to official county controls only after hold-out performance passes.
modelling_design.uncertainty: Prediction intervals must propagate model uncertainty; spatial-displacement sensitivity must be reported separately.

predeclared_validation_thresholds.justification: These are pilot publication thresholds chosen before fitting: county predictions should generally be within five percentage points of held-out official KDHS controls; final calibrated child-geography aggregates must reproduce county rates closely; ward intervals wider than 20 percentage points are considered too imprecise for a useful public point estimate. Failing any mandatory threshold blocks publication rather than relaxing the threshold post hoc.

publication_gate.reason: Required controlled microdata/geographic inputs are not present in the repository execution environment and no model has yet been fit or validated.

execution_order: Obtain authorized KDHS recode and geographic files outside the repository and record only hashes/schema metadata.
Freeze covariate registry and licences before any model fitting.
Build disclosure-safe cluster sufficient statistics and displacement-aware covariate extracts.
Run county-held-out model validation without using the held-out county control in training/calibration.
If thresholds pass, refit on all eligible data, predict grid, population-weight aggregate to constituency/ward and reconcile to official county controls.
Run P42 rate-aware back-aggregation, hold-out and uncertainty gates.
Only after every gate passes, write S5 candidate/preferred observations and update Local-54 ledgers/profiles.
